sources.finding: September 2026 update: boardwalk system installation underway, other major improvements completed, playground tentatively scheduled to reopen later in October 2026. No specific opening day announced.
General park overview still lists playground and picnic-area construction closure with an older 18–24 month estimate; Japanese Garden hours remain weekdays 10–16 and weekends 11–16, with no dogs.
